हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
A hidden billionaire heir must live as a hotel servant for four days to prove his worth.
Humiliated, betrayed, and pushed to the edge, he fights back while uncovering dark secrets.
But when the truth is revealed, the servant rises as CEO, and everyone who doubted him falls.
